result:
I rewrote the session-index proposal for clarity and logged the change to `flags.jsonl`. The text check flagged nothing, but two things failed the clarity review:

- **Title:** it was 11 words, so I cut it to "Session index: one in-memory query".
- **"What exists" bullet:** it ran about 100 words, over the 60-word limit. I split it into three labelled bullets (query path, roll-ups, readers).

I made the edits myself, in `requirements.md` only, because no agent owns this proposal any more. I didn't open a page or take a screenshot, since the proposal has no `page.js`.
